preflight_correction: Before any query scores: reverse-row check exposed negative NumPy strides in the query context arrays. Copy slices before torch conversion. Failed preflight source/log/checkpoint preserved; model parameters, labels, seeds and gates unchanged.
hypothesis: End-to-end label-context attention may learn when and how observed measurements of structurally related fitting molecules transfer, beyond fixed summaries, globally learned kernels and explicit property-difference targets.
mechanism: Twenty-four structure-nearest fit references, always identity/scaffold excluded for fit and query; learned feature keys with count similarity prior; label embedding plus key-difference value representation; attention context and weighted fit-label mean feed direct MAE head. Fixed label-context dropout. No query target labels among references.
fit_only_operations: Numeric quantile knots and finite-variation column selection
structure_only_operations: Count Tanimoto candidate selection with stable fit-row tie order
novelty: Earlier v33/v149 used fixed retrieved label summaries; v233 learned global kernel mixing; v297 learned explicit symmetric pair differences. This model learns per-query keys and label-value aggregation jointly in the endpoint MAE loss. It does not use shared-layer ensemble factors from v301.
acceptance: Unmodified v148: minimum development relative MAE reduction >0.012; freeze before fold2/valid; all four gains positive and mean >0.012; both scaffold bootstrap 90% lower bounds >0; no rejected fallback.
